statements.subject: server
statements.description: Each object in the details array MUST include a @type key that identifies the object's type.
actions: Include a @type key in every object in the error details array that identifies the object's type

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Implementations SHOULD use well-known types such as google.rpc.BadRequest to attach structured data to validation errors.
actions: Use well-known types such as google.rpc.BadRequest to attach structured data to validation errors in the details array

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Additional error context MAY be included as further objects in the details array.
actions: Optionally include additional error context objects in the error details array

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Since multiple A2A error types may map to the same HTTP status code (e.g., TaskNotCancelableError and PushNotificationNotSupportedError both map to 400 Bad Request), implementations MUST include a google.rpc.ErrorInfo object in the details array for A2A-specific errors with:
actions: Include a google.rpc.ErrorInfo object in the details array
Set reason to the A2A error type in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE without the 'Error' suffix (e.g., TASK_NOT_FOUND, TASK_NOT_CANCELABLE)
